review.why: Heavy-duty research for costly decisions: tests hypotheses, triangulates each claim across 3+ sources, saves every quote.
review.summary: Nine-phase investigation for strategy or irreversible decisions: reframe the question with falsifiable hypotheses, plan, audit available channels, search with parallel sub-agents, score sources, triangulate, run an adversarial pass, verify citations and write refresh targets. Output is a folder with one file per source and quotes.
strengths: Needs three independent source types per thesis, else flags insufficient evidence
An empty fetch gives an empty claim, never an invented citation
Refresh targets make later updates cheap
cautions: Phases are summarized in a table: step-level detail sits in a catalog file not read here
Costly in tokens and time; it says quick questions should be answered directly
Relies on sub-agents and on search channels the environment may not have
